newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraqi paper says U.S. Burns needs his head checked.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi paper says U.S. Burns needs his head checked.

text.p: An Iraqi newspaper on Sunday assailed the United States for dismissing Baghdad's claim that it uncovered a U.S. spy network and said the State Department spokesman should have his head examined.
"The denial announced by the American State Department spokesman is false and the lies uttered by American officials are many," said al-Thawra newspaper, organ of the ruling Baath party.

Right before four Iraqis appeared on Iraqi television on Friday and confessed to spying for the Central Intelligence Agency, the State Department spokesman said that anyone who believed the report needed a check-up.
"Frankly, if anybody believes these reports they ought to have their heads examined. This is a well-noted and tired propaganda ploy," Burns told a news briefing in Washington.
Thawra said: "Nobody believes the denial of the U.S. State Department spokesman and his mental powers should be examined to be sure they are sound."
